files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] kind service and entry-point main.jac; this headless slice has no npm, network or AI dependencies.

Define OSP nodes. InvestigationSession has repo_url:str, ecosystem:str='npm', status:str='pending', started_at:str='', package_count:int=0. Package has name:str, version:str, ecosystem:str='npm', is_direct:bool=False, depth:int=0, cvss_score:float=0.0, has_critical_cve:bool=False, analysis_status:str='pending'. CVE has cve_id:str, cvss_score:float=0.0, severity:str='UNKNOWN', description:str='', fixed_version:str=''. UsageContext has called_from_modules:list[str]=[], risk_surface:str='unknown', is_reachable_in_prod:bool=True, call_chain:list[str]=[]. RemediationPlan has package_name:str, current_version:str, target_version:str, breaking_changes:list[str]=[], confidence:float=0.0, status:str='proposed'.

signatures.InvestigationSession: node InvestigationSession { has repo_url: str; has ecosystem: str = "npm"; has status: str = "pending"; has started_at: str = ""; has package_count: int = 0; }
signatures.Package: node Package { has name: str; has version: str; has ecosystem: str = "npm"; has is_direct: bool = False; has depth: int = 0; has cvss_score: float = 0.0; has has_critical_cve: bool = False; has analysis_status: str = "pending"; }
signatures.CVE: node CVE { has cve_id: str; has cvss_score: float = 0.0; has severity: str = "UNKNOWN"; has description: str = ""; has fixed_version: str = ""; }

files.purpose: In-memory risk scoring with no API calls. glob HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS lists risky name fragments (jwt, auth, crypto, token, express, http, ...). package_risk_score adds 100 for depth 0, 80 for depth 1, else (10-depth)*10 when positive; +50 if the lowercased name contains a keyword; +40/+20/+10 for major version 0/1/2; +15 if direct. filter_top_risk_packages returns packages/edges unchanged with truncated False and method 'none' when within max_packages; otherwise greedily selects the max_packages highest-scoring packages (by key, first-seen wins ties), keeps only edges whose from_key and to_key are both selected, and reports truncated True, original_package_count and method 'risk_score'.

signatures.package_risk_score: def package_risk_score(name: str, version: str, depth: int, is_direct: bool) -> int
signatures.filter_top_risk_packages: def filter_top_risk_packages(packages: list[dict], edges: list[dict], max_packages: int = 200) -> dict

files.purpose: Import Package and CVE from graph.nodes and package_risk_score from tools.risk_scorer. pkg_node_id returns 'name@version'. severity_from_cvss maps >=9 CRITICAL, >=7 HIGH, >=4 MEDIUM, >0 LOW, else CLEAN. build_graph_snapshot maps parsed['packages'] keys to node ids, then for each Package node emits a dict with id, name, version, depth, is_direct, risk_score (package_risk_score of the node), cvss_score (max of the node's cvss and its outgoing CVE nodes), cve_count, is_spawn_root (id in spawn_root_ids) and severity; edges are emitted as {source, target, type:'depends_on'} only when both from_key and to_key are known. Returns {nodes, edges}.

signatures.pkg_node_id: def pkg_node_id(name: str, version: str) -> str
signatures.build_graph_snapshot: def build_graph_snapshot(session_packages: list[Package], parsed: dict, spawn_root_ids: list[str]) -> dict

files.purpose: Import Package and CVE from graph.nodes. version_gte compares dot-separated versions numerically (non-numeric parts count as 0), returning True when equal-prefix and the candidate has at least as many parts. Walker RemediationWalker has max_attempts:int=3 and plans:list[dict]=[]; on Package entry it collects outgoing CVE nodes, disengages if none or if none has a fixed_version, otherwise takes the first fixed_version, validates it with version_gte (status 'validated', confidence 0.9), appends and reports a dict {event:'remediation_plan', package, from, to, breaking_changes:[], confidence, status}, then disengages.

signatures.version_gte: def version_gte(candidate: str, minimum: str) -> bool
signatures.RemediationWalker: walker RemediationWalker { has max_attempts: int = 3; has plans: list[dict] = []; can remediate with Package entry; }

files.purpose: Thin entry point that imports and re-exports the backend slice: InvestigationSession, Package, CVE from graph.nodes; pkg_node_id, severity_from_cvss, build_graph_snapshot from graph.snapshot_util; package_risk_score, filter_top_risk_packages from tools.risk_scorer; RemediationWalker, version_gte from walkers.remediation_walker.

verify.steps: Run jac check main.jac and the Jac behavior tests for risk scoring, snapshot building and RemediationWalker.

assumption: Backend slice of shaileshdev4/depgraph (JacHacks Spring). The repo-local Python helper as_list is replaced by list() in snapshot_util and dropped from risk_scorer, and imports use root-relative module paths; network, LLM and UI modules are out of scope.
